internal_alignment: Writing W.1.3: write a narrative with events in order, details, time words, and a closing. W.1.5: focus on a topic and add details to strengthen writing. The child plans a small moment in Beginning, Middle, End (Page 1), tells it in order with First, Next, Last (Page 2), adds who, where, and feeling details (Page 3), writes the story independently on open lines (Page 4), and revises by adding a detail (Page 5). No sentence frames on the independent writing page, per the user's standing refinement that writing packs gradually reduce frames and provide genuine independent writing. Internal record only; no standards codes appear on any child page, and no separate answer key is published for this pack.
pack: Grade 1 Writing: Small Moments: My Narrative

pages_detail.activities: The child names one small moment and draws it in order: Beginning, Middle, End. The picture is a spark to get them thinking.
pages_detail.title: Plan Your Small Moment

pages_detail.activities: Three sections, First, Next, Last, matching Page 1. Three handwriting rows in each section. The child tells the moment in order, one part at a time.
pages_detail.title: Tell It in Order

pages_detail.activities: A feeling-words bank (happy, excited, proud, surprised, calm, silly) with faces, and three prompts: Who was with you? Where were you? How did you feel?
pages_detail.title: Add a Detail

pages_detail.activities: Independent writing, no sentence frames. An illustration box at the top and six open ruled lines below. The child writes the whole story here.
pages_detail.title: Write Your Story

pages_detail.activities: A short checklist, then Add one more detail, then the Revise your story panel with three numbered steps: reread the story on Page 4, choose one place to add a detail and draw a star on Page 4, write the detail into the story on Page 4.
pages_detail.title: Make It Better
